* IMPACTS...At 22.4 feet, At this level, Twin Rivers Bridge Road must
be closed.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 5:45 PM CST Friday the stage was 20.5 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 5:45 PM CST Friday was 20.5 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 22.5 feet
early tomorrow afternoon. It will then fall below flood stage
Sunday afternoon.
- Flood stage is 16.0 feet.
properties.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.

is available at https://water.noaa.gov/wfo/lsx

properties.areaDesc: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island; Interior Kuskokwim Delta; Western Capes
properties.headline: Cold Weather Advisory issued March 7 at 1:42AM AKST until March 9 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Very cold wind chills from 20 below to 40 below.

* WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta, and Western Capes.

* WHEN...Until 1 PM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...The dangerously cold wind chills as low as 40 below zero
could cause frostbite on exposed skin in as little as 10 minutes.
Frostbite and hypothermia are likely if exposed to these
temperatures. Wind chill values can lead to hypothermia with
prolonged exposure.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Cold northerly flow and enhanced wind gusts
will lead to a period of frigid wind chills over the weekend
through Monday morning. Winds expected to be relatively stronger
along the coast, but temperatures will be lower inland near
Bethel. Expect coldest temperatures overnight, increasing during
daytime hours, and returning to frigid conditions overnight. By
Monday afternoon, a slight warming trend and decrease in wind
speeds will occur, raising wind chills closer to 10 below.
properties.instruction:
Use caution while traveling outside. Wear appropriate clothing, a
hat, and gloves.

Keep pets indoors as much as possible.

Make frequent checks on older family, friends, and neighbors. Ensure
portable heaters are used correctly. Do not use generators or grills
inside.
